matching.title: Matching
matching.description: How new reports are checked against existing issues. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
matching.autoHelp: When this is off, every likely duplicate waits in the review queue for a person, however strong the match.
matching.thresholdsIntro: Each candidate gets a match score from 0 to 1. These scores decide what happens next.
matching.autoThresholdHelp: A report joins an issue without review only if it scores at least this, its photos pass the minimum below, and it's within the category's radius.
matching.reviewHelp: Below the auto-link score but at least this, a person decides. Below it, the report becomes a new issue.
matching.visualMinHelp: Stops two different problems close to each other being linked on location alone. Leave it empty to use the floor measured for the photo model in use: similarity scores mean different things for different models.
matching.visualMinModelFloor: The model in use ({model}) has a floor of {floor}.
matching.fallback: Review score when photos can't be compared
matching.fallbackHelp: Used when the AI is unavailable. Nothing is linked automatically then; matches scoring at least this go to review.
matching.weightsIntro: The match score is a weighted sum of four signals. The weights must add up to 1.
matching.weight_geo_help: Closer reports score higher, fading out over the category's radius.
matching.weight_visual_help: How alike the photos look. Ignored when there are no photos to compare.
matching.weight_category_help: Full marks for the same category, half for a related one.
matching.weight_time_help: Issues reported to recently score higher, fading over the category's window.
matching.classificationHelp: Below this, citizens aren't shown a suggested category and choose one themselves.

priority.title: Priority rules
priority.description: How each issue's priority score is worked out. Every change is recorded in the audit log, and scores are recalculated.
priority.weightsIntro: Points out of 100 for each factor at its maximum. They must add up to 100.
priority.weight_severity_help: From the category's rules, or set by staff.
priority.weight_reporters_help: Distinct people, not reports, so one person reporting many times doesn't raise it.
priority.weight_age_help: How long the issue has been open.
priority.weight_recurrence_help: Similar issues reported nearby in recent months.
priority.weight_near_places_help: A school, hospital or similar place within 150 m.
priority.severityIntro: The share of the severity points each level earns, from 0 to 1. Higher levels can't earn less.
priority.scalingIntro: Counts and ages are scaled so each factor tops out instead of growing forever.
priority.reportersSaturationHelp: Counts rise quickly at first and then level off, so a handful of people matter more than the hundredth.
priority.ageSaturationHelp: Points grow evenly each day up to this age.
priority.recurrenceRadiusHelp: How far away a similar issue can be and still count.
priority.recurrenceLookbackHelp: How far back to look for similar issues.
priority.recurrenceSaturationHelp: This many similar issues nearby earns the full recurrence points.
priority.bandsIntro: The score at which each band starts. Each must be lower than the one above.
priority.bandsLow: Anything below the Medium threshold is {band}.
priority.previewIntro: An example issue scored with the settings as they are now in the form, saved or not.
priority.previewInvalid: Fix the highlighted settings to see the preview.

recent.title: Welcome back. <muted>Here are your latest reports.</muted>
recent.empty: You haven't reported anything yet. When you do, it shows up here.

map.title: See your city, live. <muted>Every report is a pin. Every pin has a status. Every status change is public, ward by ward.</muted>
map.label: Illustration: a ward map with reports marked open, in progress and fixed
map.toast: New report · Streetlight out · MG Road

bento.title: From photo to fixed. <muted>One flow for citizens, one queue for the city, and nothing lost in between.</muted>

report.title: Report in thirty seconds. <muted>Photo, pin and category; your location fills itself in.</muted>

routed.title: Routed to the right desk. <muted>Category and ward decide who owns it.</muted>

updates.title: Every step, out loud. <muted>A message at each change of status.</muted>
updates.first: CP-2611 received. We'll keep you posted.
updates.third: Fixed ✓ Reply 1 to confirm, 2 to reopen.

proof.title: Proof, not promises. <muted>Crews close the loop with an after photo.</muted>

hindi.title: हिन्दी, first class. <muted>Every screen, message and status in both languages.</muted>
hindi.sample: बस स्टॉप के पास गहरा गड्ढा

cities.title: A work queue your teams will actually use. <muted>Triage, assign and close issues across every ward, with SLAs and a full audit trail.</muted>
cities.mapPanel: The same issues on a map, clustered by ward and coloured by status. Pick a pin to open it in the queue.

audit.first: Status changed from In progress to Fixed

features.routingBody: Category and ward decide the department. No inbox to sort.
features.slaBody: Every issue has a clock. Overdue work floats to the top.
features.auditBody: Who changed what and when, with the before and after.
features.rolesBody: Operators, supervisors and crews see only their own scope.

cta.title: Your street is waiting. <muted>Report the first thing you see on the way home tonight.</muted>

footer.label: Footer
footer.blurb: Civic reporting for Indian cities. Report it, track it, see it fixed.
footer.privacy: CivicPulse never shows your name or phone number publicly.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Updates on your reports and the work waiting for you.
notifications.bellLabelUnread: Notifications, {count, plural, one {# unread} other {# unread}}
notifications.loadError: Notifications could not be loaded. Try again shortly.
notifications.emptyBody: We'll let you know when something changes on your reports or needs your attention.

report_new_issue.title: Report {report} is now issue {issue}
report_new_issue.body: Yours is the first report of this problem. We'll keep you posted as it moves.

report_linked.title: Report {report} joined issue {issue}
report_linked.body: Others reported the same problem, so your report was added to it. You'll get its updates.

issue_status.title: Issue {issue}: {status}
issue_status.body: The issue your report is on is now “{status}”.

review_task.title: Report {report} needs a duplicate decision
review_task.body: Matching wasn't sure whether it repeats an existing issue. Open the review queue to decide.

assignment.title: Issue {issue} assigned to you
assignment.body: Open your field work to accept it and get started.

fallback.title: Update
fallback.body: Something changed. Open it for details.
